title: Italian Republic
capsule: The Italian Republic (Repubblica Italiana) was a Napoleonic client state in northern Italy, proclaimed on 26 January 1802 from the reorganized Cisalpine Republic, with Napoleon Bonaparte as president and Milan as capital. It covered Lombardy, Emilia, and the Romagna and introduced French-modeled civil law, conscription, and administrative reforms. Napoleon transformed it into the Kingdom of Italy on 17 March 1805. Though short-lived, it established administrative precedents that influenced later Italian unification.
